verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a crawl note that identifies developer.waveapps.com as the documented home of a Wave GraphQL API. That portal returned 403, so none of its documentation could be read or verified. Wave's marketing pages describe no API surface, and the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes returned 404, which does not contradict a GraphQL API. Missing for 10: readable API reference docs, evidence of auth/scopes and endpoint coverage (invoices, transactions, payroll), and any hands-on or independent confirmation that the API works.
